description: Public REST API for non-custodial USDT and USDC payments that settle directly to the merchant's wallet.
rules: Start and validate integrations in test mode before using a live key.
Keep API keys and webhook secrets server-side and read them from environment variables.
Never send currency or mode when creating an invoice; currency is USD and mode comes from the API key.
Treat every amount as a decimal string, never a floating-point number.
Fulfill only after a verified invoice.paid webhook, never from checkout or polling state.
Verify Invoq-Signature against the raw request body before parsing JSON.
Webhook delivery is at-least-once and may be out of order; deduplicate by event id and keep the highest payment_revision.
Handle invoice.payment_reversed according to the merchant's reversal policy.
